v2.AnyValue.observation: The pinned contract describes any valid JSON value and the official Rust model accepts scalar, object and array values. Its OpenAPI root object type conflicts with those alternatives; nested JSON values and null retain their documented meaning.

v1.MetricMetadata.observation: GetMetricMetadata for system.cpu.user returned null per_unit and statsd_interval on 2026-10-19. These fields describe optional unit denominators and StatsD collection settings.

v2.OrganizationAttributes.observation: 2026-10-19: authenticated current-user response included an organization with null description and url.
